sloka: तथैव च महाखड्गं चर्मणा पतितं सह।जग्राह वानरश्रेष्ठः सुग्रीवो वेगवत्तरः ।। ६.९८.३० ।।
transliteration: tathaiva ca mahākhaḍgaṁ carmaṇā patitaṁ saha।jagrāha vānaraśreṣṭhaḥ sugrīvo vegavattaraḥ ।। 6.98.30 ।।

translations.english: Then quickly getting up striking one another, both the heroes who have never been defeated, pushed each other by their arms.
